annotations.title: Ask Printdash for a custom quote (asks first)

description: Prepares a custom quote request for a job the catalogue does not cover (description, quantities, size, sides, stock, finishing, deadline, similar product, delivery address): returns the summary to show the customer and a confirmation_token. Nothing is filed or emailed until confirm is called after the customer agrees; then Printdash's team prices it by hand. Needs a signed-in Printdash account: called without one, the connection asks the customer to sign in on printdash.io.

address_id.description: A saved address id for delivery.

description.description: The job in the customer's words: what it is, size, material, finish.

similar_product_id.description: The closest catalogue product, if any.

size.description: Finished size, for example 90 x 55mm or A5.

name: request_custom_quote

summary.description: Show this to the customer exactly as written before confirming.
